The builder reads canonical state once and projects summaries, queue order, freshness, current operations, bounded recent history, and server-decided action guards at the same project revision. The illustrative melee view at revision 1842 shows session-7 at upstream-9ba1; a draining run lease blocked by two active claims; a queued sync; two active workers; PR series-18 waiting for review; knowledge revision knowledge-381 with six queued results; one running drain operation; and project.dispatch
requested sequence 92811. It projects confirmed run.hard
stop as enabled with draining → paused and sync.start as disabled by active claims with requested → ingesting.
